Copilot Instructions for VizModules

Source: .github/copilot-instructions.md

Repository Overview

VizModules is an R package (63 R files) providing interactivity-first Shiny modules for common plot types. Built on dittoViz and plotthis, all plots use plotly for interactive features.

Stack: R 4.5+, Shiny, roxygen2 | Version: 0.1.0 | License: MIT

Repository Structure

  • R/ - 63 source files: *_module_ui.R (UI), *_module_server.R (logic), *_module_app.R (examples), plus utils and standalone plot functions
  • man/ - Auto-generated roxygen2 docs (91 .Rd files)
  • data/ - 9 example datasets (example_bar, example_demographics, example_iris, example_mtcars, example_population, example_roles, example_sales, example_school_earnings, example_skills)
  • vignettes/ - quick-start.Rmd, custom-modules.Rmd, adding-a-new-module.Rmd
  • tests/testthat/ - 7 test files using testthat (expression safety, plots, stats, widgets)
  • .github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml - Builds/deploys package website to GitHub Pages
  • DESCRIPTION - Package metadata and dependencies
  • NAMESPACE - Generated by roxygen2 (NEVER EDIT MANUALLY)
  • .lintr - Line length: 120 chars, indentation: 4 spaces
  • .Rbuildignore - Files excluded from package build

Build and Validation

Prerequisites

R 4.5+, available at: C:Files.3.exe

Key R Commands

# ALWAYS run after changing roxygen2 comments or function signatures
devtools::document()          # Updates NAMESPACE and .Rd files

# Development
devtools::load_all()          # Load package for testing
devtools::check()             # Run R CMD check
lintr::lint_package()         # Lint code (120 char lines, 4-space indent)

# Building
devtools::build()             # Create .tar.gz
pkgdown::build_site()         # Build documentation website

# Testing
devtools::test()               # Run testthat test suite
dittoViz_scatterPlotApp(data = list("mtcars" = mtcars))  # Interactive testing

Build Commands (Shell)

R CMD build VizModules                                    # Build package
R CMD check --no-build-vignettes VizModules_*.tar.gz     # Quick check

CI/CD

pkgdown.yaml - Triggers on push/PR to main/master, releases, or manual dispatch. Builds docs website and deploys to gh-pages. Uses use-public-rspm: true for fast binary installs on Ubuntu.

Coding Conventions

Module Structure Pattern

Each module has 3 files: *_module_ui.R (InputsUI/OutputUI functions), *_module_server.R (Server function), *_module_app.R (create*App example).

Critical Namespace Pattern for Wrapper Modules

wrapperServer <- function(id, data_reactive) {
    # Process data INSIDE moduleServer to access namespaced inputs
    filtered_data <- moduleServer(id, function(input, output, session) {
        reactive({ /* use input$customField here */ })
    })
    # Call base module OUTSIDE to avoid double-namespacing (id-id-inputName)
    baseModuleServer(id, filtered_data)
}

In UI: Use NS(id) for wrapper’s inputs, pass bare id to base module UI functions.

Documentation Requirements

  • All exports need complete roxygen2 docs with @param, @return, @export, @author, @examples
  • Reference dittoViz parameters where applicable
  • Document missing/broken plotly functionality explicitly

Code Style

4-space indent, 120 char max line, tidyverse style guide, roxygen markdown enabled.

Dependencies

Depends: shiny, dittoViz, plotly, shinyBS, plotthis (>= 0.11.0), R (>= 4.5) | Imports: roclang, colourpicker, dplyr, DT, readxl, shinyjs, scales, shinyjqui, ggplot2, htmltools, jsonlite, methods, shinyWidgets, htmlwidgets | Suggests: knitr, rmarkdown, shinytest2, testthat

Common Issues

Issue Solution
“object not exported by namespace” Run devtools::document() to regenerate NAMESPACE
Linting failures Check .lintr: 120 char lines, 4-space indents
“Non-standard file/directory” in check Add to .Rbuildignore with regex pattern
Module inputs not responding Namespace issue - verify NS(id) pattern (see above)
Vignette build errors Install: install.packages(c("knitr", "rmarkdown"))

Critical Rules

  1. NEVER edit NAMESPACE manually - always use devtools::document()
  2. ALWAYS run devtools::document() after changing roxygen2 comments or signatures
  3. Run devtools::test() after changes to verify the testthat test suite passes; also test modules interactively via example apps
  4. Follow namespace pattern strictly for wrapper modules (see Coding Conventions)
  5. All plots must use plotly - this is a plotly-based package
  6. Document missing features - clearly note functionality unavailable in plotly
  7. Use organize_inputs() helper for consistent UI layouts

Best Practices

  • Avoid sapply usage, it is unsafe in package code.

Trust these instructions - only search for additional info if incomplete or incorrect.
